words: Contract 0.4.0 of account_return_daily, from 0.3.0. What changed: external_flow and income_received stay non-nullable in general but become nullable ONLY where source is orion, each carrying nullable_when source orion and flow_claim absent. Two optional columns are added: flow_claim (values absent, reason vendor-reported return, not built from flows) and source_account_id (int64, Orion's integer account id). The contract gains source_rules.orion (flows, business_date, account_id), the 0.3.0 supersedes entry and a recomputed schema_hash_with_optional. What did not move: the 19 columns, their names, types, meanings and schema_hash; the other 17 columns; the source column; served_day_rules, byte-identical. Every 0.3.0 writer still validates, because no existing type changes and the new columns are optional. What is NOT proven: that the Orion adapter emits rows this way. That is a later cell of another seat; no producer, adapter or handler was edited here.
